digest.component_or_area: workflow execution framework - plan-review prerequisites, step registry, seam tests
propositions: Step registry membership for plan-review workflow ops cannot be asserted in-process because test imports mask the defect; subprocess isolation with clean sys.modules is required to catch missing registration imports

The headroom guard on gate_dispatch.py references finalize_verdict call sites that were moved to plan_review_recovery.py and workflow_ops.py, making the rationale stale; the guard must name the actual files holding those sites

plan_review/workflow_ops.py (794 LOC) and llm/config.py (793 LOC) lack headroom assertions while they exceed 700 LOC; staged assertion at < 800 protects against regrowth pending sibling extraction tickets that will tighten to < 700

Workflow schema permits unknown step names as free-form strings; linter skips validation for unregistered steps; existing completeness tests iterate only the registry itself, rendering a missed registration import invisible at every layer except runtime
Gate YAML resolution must be tested in subprocess isolation against STEP_REGISTRY to detect when registration imports are removed, using the same clean sys.modules pattern as the membership check
